text_block_list.text:
At the store where I came to pick out 
shoes with <chrname>, I spotted Trainer Kiryuin and 
her group.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>. Are you here to pick out 
shoes as well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A first-rate Umamusume deserves 
first-rate equipment, after all.

Beside Trainer Kiryuin, who was full of 
enthusiasm, I began picking out shoes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Look, Bitter Glas! Those shoes are the 
latest model featured in the magazine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Its effectiveness is scientifically 
proven, and girls who achieve great 
results all swear by it.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ......I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However, strictly from the standpoint of 
running ease, the pair next to it is also 
hard to pass up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This model has superior cushioning and 
puts less strain on the legs.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Considering your running style, it might 
be better to go with this one.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

After nodding, Happy Meek opened her mouth 
as if to say something, but ended up 
closing it without uttering a word.

Following her gaze, a pair of shoes 
catches my eye. Most likely, Meek is—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Alright, I've decided!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to pay the bill, so please wait 
here, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you don't have to say you 
want those shoes?

Is it really okay not to say you want 
those shoes?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
......No. Because I have... the shoes that 
Trainer chose for me.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is always thinking about me ...and 
working so hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...So, it's really fine... I only thought 
those shoes looked like baguettes, that's 
all~
choice_data_list:
They'll appreciate it more if you share 
your honest feelings.

They'll be happier if you share your 
honest feelings.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Do you... think so?
choice_data_list: I understand, because I'm a Trainer too.
I understand. I'm a Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you very much. I'll be on my 
way now....”

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Meek...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In my eagerness to do what I thought was 
best, I ended up leaving you behind, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"What matters is whether these are the 
best shoes for Meek or not. ...I should 
have asked for your feelings first."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Let's choose shoes again. ...Together, 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, thank you for looking out for 
Meek.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you from me as well.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time, I'll discuss it with my 
Trainer before picking out shoes."

After seeing off Trainer Kiryuin and the 
others, I discussed shoe choices together 
with <chrname>.
